description: The function choosing \(f(x)\) when \(R(x)\) holds and \(g(x)\) otherwise equals \(\chi_R(x)f(x)+(1\mathbin{\dot-}\chi_R(x))g(x)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic_cases.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (R : α → Prop) (f g : α → ℕ)
  (x : α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic R x * f x +
      (1 - Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PrimitiveRecursion.characteristic R x) * g x =
    if R x then f x else g x
